long_biography.plain_text:
Russian Ferro-Alloys provided the platform for Sergei Antipov's American metals career. Founded in northern Indiana in 2001, the company imported ferrosilicon for steelmakers. By 2013, Antipov was appearing publicly as its chief executive and owner, placing him at the centre of commercial decisions in a specialised industrial market.

At the same Mishawaka address and phone number, Ferronix carries forward the specialist operation, and industry material identifies Antipov as its chief executive. The company's distribution model has relied on importing large volumes and carrying substantial inventories to reduce logistics costs. That operating continuity—from Russian Ferro-Alloys to Ferronix—defines Antipov's durable public identity as a US-based owner-operator in ferroalloy distribution.
